title: Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Turkish dish featuring marinated lamb kebabs grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of crusty bread and a salad for a hearty meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked through and slightly charred.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and brush with lemon juice. Garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve immediately, with a side of crusty bread and a salad.
